totals.unit: gwei at the pinned state, not time-weighted principal

requiredBeforeEconomicUse: A fixed economically identified cohort; eight registry indices are not a representative staking or investor universe.
Exact UTC boundary states and every relevant state transition across the full 28-day window.
Separate actual earned consensus rewards/penalties from deposits, withdrawals and consolidation principal crossing cohort boundaries.
Reconcile execution priority fees and additional MEV without counting builder payments twice.
Measured service fees, remaining operating costs and dated conversions for precisely the same cohort.
Time-weighted reward-eligible principal; neither one ending actual balance nor count times 32 ETH is the denominator.
Accepted full-exit request and execution-availability histories; one withdrawal_done state supplies no waiting duration.
Authenticated canonical states or membership proofs and independent finality checks; header hashing alone is insufficient.

stockFlowReconciliation.convention: Conditionally treat supplyWei at the row label as the end-of-slot stock; require labels at the preceding and final requested slots. Include every exact-window flow row, exclude the predecessor flow.

requestedUtcWindow.interpretation: Bucket sums remain provider claims even when integer arithmetic and requested slot boundaries align. No proration, missing-zero fill, or epoch-to-UTC relabeling.

utcAlignment.condition: Every future relevant stock label must retain this observed stride and label residue. Changing API resolution or grid origin invalidates this conditional conclusion.
utcAlignment.mathematicalCriterion: An observed label residue b modulo m can meet the UTC boundary sequence a+n*d iff gcd(m,d) divides a-b.

remaining: Definition-matched complete 26-metric snapshots including measured non-fee execution destruction
Actual publication and collection vintages available by each historical origin
Cohort-specific earned net staking returns and disjoint underlying collateral
Enough same-horizon matured labels and market regimes

unchangedCurrentBase.scope: This boundary holds only while these exact base bytes remain unchanged. The separate committed-base reader permits an explicitly reviewed committed replacement; it does not generate or schedule that replacement.

remainingOperationalRequirements: Actually capture, publish and durably preserve each future issuance and its raw outcomes
An actually activated reviewed trigger and successful remote archive append/readback on the daily path; definitions alone cannot prove continuous operation
Reviewed committed base updates before the unchanged-base request boundary
A bounded archival/streaming design that preserves all required evidence beyond current flat inventory limits
First twelve exact-bound nonoverlapping actual windows with all selected outcomes; no substitution or retrospective issues

artifactSourceScope.commitToTreeBoundary: Caller supplies the remote tree obtained for expectedCommit; offline verification binds all payload blobs to that supplied tree.

browserVerification.policy: isExpectedOfflineBtcRefresh plus the existing failed UI and retained archive witnesses; numeric quote checked only for outlook

limitations: Raw-byte and model-consistency replay does not independently authenticate provider membership, finality, publication history or economic completeness.
Endpoint supply arithmetic uses retained provider buckets. It is not a substitute for exact UTC-window boundary stocks and flows.
A validator balance change is not measured staking earned return. Deposits, withdrawals, consolidations, costs and reward-eligible principal remain separate requirements.
Only the selected twenty files are staged. The complete artifact, source-book and PNG payloads are not permanently retained by this operation.
